verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a desktop Linux distribution, so integrating online accounts for calendar, contacts, and data is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an online-accounts feature or calendar/contact sync. The closest items are bundled apps and countdown reminders, which are adjacent features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can bring my online calendar, contacts, and data into the desktop with online account integration
